gates.name: Outline
gates.desc: Scope, required components, and venue-fit structure locked.

gates.name: Draft
gates.desc: Complete first draft of every required component.

gates.name: Review 1 (content)

gates.name: Audit 1 (claim/evidence)
gates.desc: Every claim and number traced to key_results.md / repo artifacts.

gates.name: Review 2 (reviewer sim)
gates.desc: Adversarial peer-review read simulating the venue's reviewers.

gates.name: Audit 2 (compliance)
gates.desc: Format, length, eligibility, integrity, and claim-boundary compliance.
gates.pass: Length/format limits met; eligibility satisfied; no fabricated affiliation; retrospective claim boundaries held.

gates.name: Copyedit + AI-tell pass
gates.desc: Line editing and removal of AI-generated-writing tells.

gates.name: Production (format/proof)
gates.desc: Convert to the venue's required artifact (PDF/DOCX/portal/poster) with figures.
gates.pass: Final artifact in required format renders correctly with figures/refs embedded.

gates.name: Final QA gate
gates.desc: Submission-ready check: portal fields, attachments, signatures, disclosures.
gates.pass: Every portal field, attachment, signature, and disclosure ready; last official-site refresh done.

gates.name: Submitted
gates.desc: Submitted to the venue; confirmation captured.
gates.pass: Submission confirmed; confirmation ID / email archived.

gates.name: Decision
gates.pass: Outcome and any reviewer feedback recorded.

priority_formula.description: composite 0-100 = weighted sum of four 0-100 sub-scores (raw desirability). effective = composite x actionability; venues are RANKED by effective so a blocked/ineligible venue does not outrank real targets on deadline urgency alone.
